questions.question: King Zedekiah of Judah sent two men to the prophet Jeremiah. What did he ask Jeremiah to do?

answers.text: Pray to the LORD for them
Give them a sign from the LORD
Offer a sacrifice to the LORD

questions.question: The LORD said the Chaldeans would come back and burn down Jerusalem after Pharaoh's army went home. True or false?
When Jeremiah tried to leave Jerusalem, the captain of the guard grabbed him. Who did he accuse Jeremiah of deserting to?
After Jeremiah had been in prison a long time, King Zedekiah asked for a word from the LORD. What did Jeremiah say?

answers.text: The king would be handed over to Babylon's king
The Chaldeans would go away for good
Pharaoh's army would come and rescue the king
